# Public site (dockyrd.io)

The marketing + user documentation site lives in **`site/`**. It is **static HTML/CSS/JS** (no backend). Production URL: **https://dockyrd.io**.

## Source vs output

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `site/source.html` | Editable design source (sections, copy, doc articles) |
| `site/index.html`, `site/docs/*.html`, `site/assets/*` | **Generated** — run `make site` or `node scripts/build-public-site.mjs` |
| `docs/user/*.md` | Repo-local user docs; keep aligned with public site for install/CLI paths |

Do not hand-edit generated files under `site/` except `source.html` and `site/README.md`.

## When to update (mandatory)

Update the public site **in the same cycle** when you change user-visible product behavior, install paths, CLI commands, or onboarding copy:

1. Edit **`site/source.html`** (or matching **`docs/user/*.md`** when that is the clearer source).
2. Run **`make site`** and commit generated output with the product change.
3. If **`web/lib/public-links.ts`** constants change, update dashboard links in the same PR.

## Dashboard links

The embedded **Dockyrd** panel must link to the public site, not GitHub:

- Announcement / learn more → `PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN`
- Header **Docs** and user menu **Documentation** → `PUBLIC_DOCS_INTRO_URL` (or `/docs/`)

## SEO

Build emits per-page `<title>`, description, canonical, Open Graph, `sitemap.xml`, and `robots.txt`. Prefer real paths (`/docs/installation.html`) over hash-only routing.

## Hosting

Deploy the **`site/`** directory as a Dockyard **static site** (see `site/README.md`). Self-hosting Dockyrd on the same VPS is the expected setup.

## Install command

Until `get.dockyard.dev` is live, the public install one-liner uses the **raw GitHub** `scripts/install.sh` on **`development`**. Do not switch to `get.dockyrd.io` / `get.dockyard.dev` without an explicit product decision.

Cross-ref: [product-naming](../../.cursor/rules/product-naming.mdc) (Dockyard CLI vs Dockyrd UI).
